info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Site Operations Management API
info.description: The Site Operations Management API provides access to real-time information about site operations related to banking facilities. This endpoint allows users to retrieve details specific to a site given a unique identifier. It is designed for developers and businesses needing to integrate site data into their applications, facilitating insights for operational efficiency and decision-making. Typical consumers include banking system integrators, operational analysts, and business intelligence tools seeking to enhance reporting and analytics capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific site operation.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve detailed information about a specific site operation identified by its unique ID. It returns relevant data related to the site operation, enabling users to understand its status and specifics.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary input parameters for retrieving site operations data for the specified facility. Ensure that the JSON structure conforms to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the requested data has been returned.
